grammarFocus: 学术论证的限定、因果、对比与证据范围
title: Choosing a defensible survey sample
instructions: 原创学术微训练；场景、机构与数值均为虚构模拟，不是事实报道或官方试题。先独立盲听答题，再用原句核对限定、比较与因果。短篇专项不能替代完整陌生测评。
transcript:
Tutor: Tell me who you want your survey results to describe.
Nina: All first-year students. I planned to recruit volunteers from the photography society because I know its organiser.
Tutor: Convenient recruitment may influence the result. What is your actual question?
Nina: Whether students find the evening library useful. I initially wrote about satisfaction with the whole university, but I have narrowed it to one service.
Tutor: How could you reach students outside the society?
Nina: I could invite students from six introductory classes, including morning and evening groups rather than a single timetable.
Tutor: How many responses are you seeking?
Nina: Eighty. I first suggested fifty, but eighty would let me compare commuters with people living on campus, provided both groups reply.
Tutor: Do not promise equal representation before recruitment. What if commuters reply less often?
Nina: I will report the response rate separately for each group. I will also offer a paper version, so participation does not depend entirely on checking an email.
Tutor: What personal details will you collect?
Nina: Only a broad travel category, not names or exact addresses. The consent statement will explain that participation is voluntary.
Tutor: When will the pilot happen?
Nina: On Thursday. The final questionnaire will wait until five pilot participants have explained what they think each question means.

grammar.title: 用条件句限定预测
grammar.explanation: if 从句说明条件；常见真实将来条件句在 if 从句用一般现在时，主句可用 will。不要把有条件的推测改成已经发生的事实。
grammar.example: I planned to recruit volunteers from the photography society because I know its organiser.

questions.prompt: If the sample _____, the estimate will become more stable. （只填空白，保持其余文字不变）
questions.explanation: if 从句说明条件；常见真实将来条件句在 if 从句用一般现在时，主句可用 will。不要把有条件的推测改成已经发生的事实。 本句为：If the sample grows, the estimate will become more stable.
questions.evidence: If the sample grows, the estimate will become more stable.

questions.prompt: If fuel prices _____, the council will revise its budget. （只填空白，保持其余文字不变）
questions.explanation: if 从句说明条件；常见真实将来条件句在 if 从句用一般现在时，主句可用 will。不要把有条件的推测改成已经发生的事实。 本句为：If fuel prices rise, the council will revise its budget.
questions.evidence: If fuel prices rise, the council will revise its budget.

questions.prompt: If the sensor _____, the recorder will display a warning. （只填空白，保持其余文字不变）
questions.explanation: if 从句说明条件；常见真实将来条件句在 if 从句用一般现在时，主句可用 will。不要把有条件的推测改成已经发生的事实。 本句为：If the sensor fails, the recorder will display a warning.
questions.evidence: If the sensor fails, the recorder will display a warning.

questions.prompt: If users _____, their comments will be stored. （只填空白，保持其余文字不变）
questions.explanation: if 从句说明条件；常见真实将来条件句在 if 从句用一般现在时，主句可用 will。不要把有条件的推测改成已经发生的事实。 本句为：If users agree, their comments will be stored.
questions.evidence: If users agree, their comments will be stored.

part1: What do you usually read about this topic?
Have you ever made a choice involving planning a student survey?
What information would help you make that choice?
Who would you ask for a different opinion?
speaking.part2: Describe a decision about planning a student survey. You should say what the decision was, what alternatives were available, what evidence you used, and explain what you would check before recommending it to others.
part3: What makes questions easy to misunderstand?
How should missing replies be reported?

transfer.writing: Write an evidence-based paragraph of 120–160 words about planning a student survey. State one claim, support it with a relevant example, acknowledge a limitation, and explain what further evidence would change your conclusion. Use a new example; do not copy the passage.
